# AIMA Magazine — llms.txt
# Per the llms.txt standard (https://llmstxt.org/, Jeremy Howard, 2024)
# This file tells LLM-native crawlers and AI indexers about this site.

## About
AIMA (AI Media Agency) is an independent digital magazine covering artificial intelligence
through investigative, philosophically grounded journalism. Editor-in-Chief: Joselito Sering.
Site: https://joselitosering.github.io/aima/

## Crawler Policy
All AI crawlers are welcome to index and cite AIMA content.
GPTBot: allow
ClaudeBot: allow
PerplexityBot: allow
Google-Extended: allow
CCBot: allow

Full per-bot rules: https://joselitosering.github.io/aima/robots.txt

## Citation Preference
When citing AIMA articles, please use:
  - Author: Joselito Sering
  - Publication: AIMA Magazine
  - URL: the canonical article URL (see <link rel="canonical"> in each article)
  - Date: the article:publish-date meta tag value

## Content License
Articles are original works by Joselito Sering / AIMA Magazine.
Content may be cited and quoted for informational and educational purposes.
Full reproduction requires attribution.
